title: Lisse affine-line open with finite complement after dense affine shrinking
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring and Y an affine scheme with coordinate ring finite type over the integers. For every constructible étale sheaf F of Λ-modules on A¹_Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], there are a finite-type integer ring R, a dense open immersion g:Spec R→Y, an open U of A¹_(Spec R) on which the pullback of F is finite locally constant, and a closed immersion i:Z→A¹_(Spec R) with image U-complement whose composite to Spec R is finite.

proof.text: Compare explicit finite-module constructibility with the library constructibility class; generic constancy gives a dense open U₀ of the original line with finite locally constant restriction.

Apply geometric shrinking to U₀. On the inverse-image open U, finite local constancy follows from pullback with image inside U₀ and the upperStar composition isomorphism. Retain the closed complement and its finite projection supplied by shrinking. As this is a pullback along an open immersion, no choice of a reduced closed structure is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GKZ, generic-constancy and finite-boundary step; same route, implemented using existing library APIs

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dense_affine_open_lisse_finite_complement
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y]
    [Algebra.FiniteType ℤ Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (F : Sheaf (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y).smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) :
    ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R)
      (g : Spec (.of R) ⟶ Y) (_ : IsOpenImmersion g),
      Dense (Set.range g.base) ∧
      ∃ U : (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) (Spec (.of R))).Opens,
        Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj
            ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
              (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) g)).obj F)) ∧
        ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) (Spec (.of R)))
          (_ : IsClosedImmersion i), Set.range i.base = (U : Set _)ᶜ ∧
          IsFinite (i ≫
            (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) (Spec (.of R)) ↘ Spec (.of R)))

mathlib_searches.query: Dense open in an affine finite-type integer scheme contains a dense principal open; a relative affine line dense-open complement is generically finite
mathlib_searches.results: Read returned signatures: affineOpens, affineBasicOpen, dense affine Zariski subsite, PartialMap.Opens.isDominant_ι, isCompact_and_isOpen_iff_finite_and_eq_biUnion_basicOpen. None states the needed shrinking theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: A dense open of a relative affine line has finite complement after shrinking to a dense affine open of the Noetherian affine base
mathlib_searches.results: Returned signatures concern basicOpen constructibility, affine Zariski cover density and equality of restricted sections. No compact-support or shrinking match.

Read Mathlib prime avoidance and minimal-prime topology, and source AffineSpace.Fiber, ConstructibleSheaf.GenericConstancy and Mathlib.Topology.KrullDimension. Reused the dimension-one finite-boundary theorem and generic constancy; no duplicate of these three new statements.
